title: 比较级最高级构成

examples.en: This is the most interesting book of the three.
examples.zh: 这是三本书中最有趣的一本。

guess.question: interesting 的比较级为什么是 more interesting，而不是 interestinger？

options.text: 因为它是多音节词，比较级要在前面加 more，不能加 -er
options.feedback: 对！三个音节以上的词一律用 more / most，不能加 -er。
不对——判断依据是音节多少，不是结尾字母。
不对——interestinger 是错的，只能用 more interesting。

rule.rule: 单音节和少数双音节词加 -er / -est；多音节词前面加 more / most；还有一批不规则变化需要单独记
rule.formula: ① 单音节：tall → taller → tallest　② 辅音 + y：heavy → heavier → heaviest　③ 重读闭音节双写末辅音：big → bigger → biggest　④ 多音节：interesting → more interesting → most interesting　⑤ 不规则：good / well → better → best；bad → worse → worst；many / much → more → most

anchors.en: This is the most interesting book I have read.
anchors.zh: 这是我读过的最有趣的书。

trap.wrong: This book is interestinger than that one.
trap.right: This book is more interesting than that one.
trap.why: 多音节词比较级用 more，不能加 -er。

guess_callback: 你刚才选的是 A——短词加 -er/-est，长词加 more/most，good-better-best 这类单独记。

check.stem: Which is ____, the sun or the moon?
check.explanation: 两者比较 → bigger（重读闭音节双写 g）。

check.stem: I think English is ____ than maths.

options.distractor: 有 than 要用比较级

check.explanation: 多音节词比较级 → more interesting。

This book is gooder than that one.
This book is more good than that one.
This book is best than that one.
options.distractor: best 是最高级，不接 than
